desc: Parse input and build the functional graph (adjacency list for reverse edges to identify trees, and detect cycles).
Decompose the graph into connected components and identify the cycle in each component.
For each component, contract the cycle into a super-node and identify the trees rooted at the cycle nodes.
Implement a DP to compute for each node $u$ in a tree, the function $f_u(v) = $ number of ways to assign the subtree at $u$ given $x_u = v$. Use prefix sums to optimize the transition.
For each component, compute the total number of valid assignments by summing over $v=1 \dots M$ the product of the ways for each tree attached to the cycle nodes.
Multiply the results from all components modulo 998244353 and print the answer.
